testcase.name: the order of manual 10: content type, size, syntax, duplicate keys, schema, idempotency key, path id, agency selector
the header-only head of the order (a repeated envelope header, then the content type) is decided before a body exists; everything else waits for the body
an admitted request carries the validated body, the path ids, the selector of its scope and the client address hash; the envelope binds the subject
R28: a malformed client correlation id is never refused and never adopted — the server mints its own; a well-formed one is adopted; a missing one is minted
R40: the body is decoded as strict UTF-8 — an invalid byte sequence or a byte order mark is JSON_SYNTAX, never replaced; valid multi-byte text is admitted unchanged
a charset parameter is accepted only as utf-8
CMD025-OK golden vector: approvalHashOf over the fixed KAURO_PLAN_APPROVAL_V1 preimage equals the hex derived outside the product; the test oracle reproduces it
every one of the nine members is bound by the approval hash, and the domain separates it from every other digest class
every in-scope spec matches the catalogue entry: method, path, role, fields in order
request schemas are closed 2020-12 objects whose properties are exactly the catalogue fields, typed by the field vocabulary
no request schema exposes a server-owned member (verified, agencyOwner, state, agencyId, version, hashes of bytes)
scope resolution: only CreateAgency runs without a tenant; agency-path routes carry agencyId; the rest use the header
CMD001 OK: one DRAFT agency and one ACTIVE OWNER membership, two events, one outbox row, journal COMMITTED, 201
CMD001 DENY: an admission refusal or a second DRAFT for the same creator commits nothing
CMD001 RACE: identical retry replays the same agency; the same key with another displayName is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT with no effect
CMD009 OK: an OPERATOR creates a client; two clients may share a label and keep distinct ids; one event each
CMD009 DENY: a foreign processing authority is UNKNOWN_REFERENCE with a field error, a non-member is NOT_FOUND, a closed agency is AGENCY_NOT_OPEN; no row in any case
CMD010 OK: ARCHIVED at version 2 with the retained work reported; projects stay; CreateProject on it is then CLIENT_ARCHIVED
CMD010 DENY / RACE: a foreign client is NOT_FOUND; a stale expectedVersion is 409 with the current version and state; the second of two archives on one version loses; identical retry replays
CMD011 OK: a CLEAN project with its DRAFT revision, capability snapshot and readiness blockers; two events
CMD011 DENY: a mode without an offered capability is 422 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE before anything else exists; a CRM mode without targetInstanceRef is 400; nothing is written
CMD023 OK: predecessor SUPERSEDED (v5) naming its successor; successor VALIDATION_REQUIRED (v2) with a new body hash and no receipt; impact map; three events; EXECUTION_CONTROL outbox

CMD023 DENY: unknown patch → 400 UNKNOWN_REFERENCE; compiler rejection → 400 with the patch reason; same body → NO_SEMANTIC_CHANGE; expectedVersion of a superseded plan → STALE_VERSION carrying successorId; no new row
CMD025 OK: an immutable approval bound to the exact plan/source/target/receipt/disclosures with a recomputable KAURO_PLAN_APPROVAL_V1 hash; plan APPROVED v5; two events; NOTIFICATIONS outbox

CMD025 DENY: stale receipt → 422 PLAN_NOT_VALIDATED; disclosures without the CLEAR set → 409 STALE_VERSION mismatch [disclosuresHash]; wrong planHash → mismatch [planHash]; expired source → 422 SOURCE_EXPIRED; superseded target → 422 TARGET_STALE; nothing committed
CMD025 RACE: two approvers on one version → one 201, one 409 STALE_VERSION; identical retry replays; conflicting same key → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; one live approval

CMD026 OK: the approving actor withdraws; approval carries withdrawnAt/reason at version 2; plan WITHDRAWN v6; receipts and the approval row stay; outbox NOTIFICATIONS + EXECUTION_CONTROL; completed external actions listed separately

CMD026 DENY / RACE: another APPROVER is NOT_APPROVAL_CONTROLLER (and a denial security event); an OWNER may withdraw; a plan not APPROVED is PRECONDITION_FAILED; the second withdrawal loses; a withdrawal cannot be undone
a crash after the inserts and before COMMIT leaves nothing: no agency, no membership, no event, no outbox row, no journal row
a DomainFailure raised by a port after the journal reservation rolls the reservation back and is answered as a problem; an unexpected exception propagates as is
a tenant command without an agency selector is refused before any unit of work opens
the validator compiles exactly the 73 contracts, the 7 request schemas, the 8 response schemas, the 3 declared replies of the operational routes, the 5 read replies and Problem, and nothing else
a schema with a keyword the validator cannot enforce, a foreign $ref, an unknown format or an open extension map is refused at compile time
R2-059: unknown members reject with their names and no value; R2-058: a string is not a boolean, a string is not an integer, nothing is coerced or defaulted
date-time is a real Gregorian instant with at most three fractional digits in Z form; 2026-02-30 is the rejection control
nested contracts: $ref chains validate data as data (TargetContract.objects is an array of TargetObject values), errors carry paths
every Problem the application produces validates against the closed Problem schema
every code of manual 10 is a failure code with a status and a title; platform additions are exactly three
problems carry code, reason, current version and next actions but never the internal message or SQL
readiness blockers: every missing fact is named once, in a fixed order; an approved plan on a sealed revision of an active agency has none
views never carry internal columns: no createdByUserId on an agency view, no revokedAt or updatedAt on a membership view; permitted actions derive from the role

R23: every view member taken from the registry is the registry member, narrowed only by keywords the registry lacks; a registry-required member stays required; every registry member is selected or withheld with a reason
R23: the build refuses a registry member a view neither selects nor withholds, a registry-required member left optional, a narrowing that overrides a registry keyword and a missing contract
R29: ApprovalView selects every member of the KAURO_PLAN_APPROVAL_V1 preimage as required, and actorId is the registry's Approval.actorId
R23: every response schema is closed and none declares a forbidden member; an operational route that would declare one, or leave an object open, is refused

R23: the validator compiles the COMPLETED envelope of every served command, the ACCEPTED envelope and the declared replies of operational routes; operational routes are declared and checked like command routes

R23: checkReply refuses an undeclared status, another content type, a closed-schema violation and a problem whose status is not the HTTP status; it names paths and codes, never values; the replacement problem is itself a valid Problem
R23 / R29: the COMPLETED reply of each of the seven handlers satisfies its response schema; the approval view recomputes its KAURO_PLAN_APPROVAL_V1 hash from its own members
KnownSchemaId is exactly the contract names, the request schema ids, the response schema ids and Problem
the generated TargetContract schema types customer metadata as data (closed object with an objects array), never as a schema
parses RFC 8259 values exactly like JSON.parse for well-formed input
duplicate keys are refused at any depth (JSON.parse would keep the last one)
depth and string length are bounded
syntax errors: trailing commas, comments, NaN, leading zeros, single quotes, control characters, lone surrogates, BOM, trailing garbage, bad escapes
prototype-polluting member names are refused
